entities.name: Table T1 – Hyperscalers Market Presence Equity vs IG Debt
entities.brief: Contrasting hyperscalers’ equity vs IG debt market shares
entities.description: Time-series data from 2013 to 2025 showing hyperscalers’ equity market share growth vs stable low debt presence.

properties.key_insight: Hyperscalers’ equity share grew from about 4.5% in 2013 to nearly 18% by 2025, while their IG debt share remained below 2%.

entities.name: Table T2 – Hyperscaler Bond Issuance Dollars and Percentage
entities.brief: Annual hyperscaler bond issuance and share of total IG issuance
entities.description: Time-series data showing hyperscaler bond issuance in USD bn and as percentage of total IG issuance from 2013 to 2025.

properties.key_insight: Hyperscaler bond issuance peaked at $33bn in 2017 and $32bn in 2022, then declined to $9bn in 2023 and is projected at $6bn by 2025.
